stem.text: $\beta$-carotene is responsible for the orange colour of carrots.

stem.alt: Skeletal structure of beta-carotene, labelled beta-carotene: two six-membered rings with gem-dimethyl groups, joined by a long conjugated chain of C=C bonds with CH3 substituents.

stem.text: $\beta$-carotene is oxidised by hot, concentrated, acidified $\text{KMnO}_4$.
When an individual molecule of $\beta$-carotene is oxidised in this way, many product molecules are formed.
How many of these product molecules contain a ketone functional group?
